title: EDGENOVA'26 Official Notice
content: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, School of Computing, Department of Computational Intelligence in association with SRMIST ACM SIGAI presents EDGENOVA'26, a 24-Hour National Level Hackathon on August 27 & 28, 2026 at Mini Hall 2, SRM KTR. Team size 1-4 members. Prize pool ₹40,000. Registration fee: Screening ₹50, Final round ₹250 (Total advertised ₹300 per participant). Eligibility: UG & PG students. Benefits include prizes, certificates for round 1 clearers, and refreshments. Screening online, final offline at SRMIST.
